notes: Checked against the Open Problem Library's wiki page and the OPL_LICENSE file in its repository (main branch). Unless a problem says otherwise, it is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 Unported, with copyright held by its authors. NonCommercial, so a paid app only links to it. Some contributions carry another open-source licence, stated in their top-level folder or below a problem's END_DOCUMENT() line; such a problem would need its own check before anything more than a link. The earlier figure of about 35,000 problems came from a search result and was dropped. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
